blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Mayor Akmad Mitra Ampatuan Jr. of Shariff Aguak, Maguindanao del Sur, has lauded the arrest of one of the suspects in the rocket-propelled grenade (RPG) ambush against him last January 25. Mayor Ampatuan commended the police for arresting Toraipe Lusod on Saturday, October 24, in Barangay Meta, Datu Unsay, Maguindanao del Sur. Lusod is a co-accused of Datu Unsay Mayor Andal Ampatuan V, whom Akmad claimed as the alleged mastermind in the latest failed attempt to kill him.
